title: Grocery receipt
description: One parsed grocery receipt. All money values are in dollars. Never store card numbers, loyalty IDs, names or phone numbers.

id.description: Same as the file's base name: YYYY-MM-DD_store-slug_HHMM (optionally _2, _3 ... if two receipts share a minute).

chain.description: Lowercase slug for the store chain, e.g. 'trader-joes'. Also the key used in aliases.json.

name.description: Human-readable store name, e.g. "Trader Joe's - Downtown".

payment_type.description: How it was paid. Only the kind of payment, NEVER a card number.

image_path.description: Path of the receipt photo, relative to the repository root.

parsed_at.description: When the receipt was turned into JSON, ISO 8601 date-time.

line_no.description: 1-based position of the item on the receipt.

receipt_text.description: Item description exactly as printed (without item/UPC codes or the price column).

product_key.description: Key into products.json. null only for non-product lines (bag fee, bottle deposit, whole-order coupon).

quantity.description: Number of packages (unit_of_sale 'each') or the weight (unit_of_sale 'lb'/'kg').

price_paid.description: What the whole line actually cost after discounts. Negative only for non-product lines such as an order-level coupon.

regular_price.description: What the whole line would have cost without discounts.

discount.description: Total discount applied to this line (positive number). regular_price - discount = price_paid.

weighed.description: True for items priced by weight, e.g. '1.32 lb @ $0.69/lb'.
